SELECT
  t1.*,
  conv_symbol_to_token_v2(t1.ex, t1.s) token_1,
  t2.ccid
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ex, s, k
  FROM (
    SELECT ex, s, k
    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ex, s, k
    FROM default.tickers
  )
  WHERE (k = 'fut' AND ex != 'binance') OR (k = 'spot' AND ex = 'bybit')
) t1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT *
  FROM default.ex_k_to_ccid
  WHERE k = 'fut'
) t2
  ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
WHERE t2.ccid = ''
  AND startsWith(notes, 'not-on-ui-on-') = 0
  AND startsWith(notes, 'delisted-on-') = 0
  AND startsWith(notes, 'index-fut-custom-for-ex-') = 0
ORDER BY ex, s

  groupArrayIf(s, k = 'spot') s_spot,
  sum(if(k = 'fut', p_bid_per_1_token, 0)) p_bid_fut,
  sum(if(k = 'spot', p_ask_per_1_token, 0)) p_ask_spot,
  groupArrayIf(ts_write, k = 'fut') ts_write_fut,
  groupArrayIf(ts_write, k = 'spot') ts_write_spot

  SELECT
    *,

      row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ex, t1.k, t2.ccid ORDER BY t1.ts_write DESC) as rank_last_events_on_ex

      UNION ALL

        CONCAT(if(k = 'fut', 'https://kucoin.com/futures/trade/', 'https://kucoin.com/trade/margin/'), s) ex_link
      FROM default.tickers
      WHERE ex = 'kucoin' AND _p_bid != 'null'

        *,

        toFloat64(_p_bid) p_bid,
        if (k = 'fut', JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.ask1'), JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.askPrice')) _p_ask,
        toFloat64(_p_ask) p_ask,

          array(JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.volume'), JSON_VALUE(obj_raw, '$.quoteVolume'))
        ) volumes,

        ) ex_link

    ) t1
    LEFT JOIN default.ex_k_to_ccid_v2 t2 USING (ex, k, s)
    WHERE ts_write >= NOW() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTES
    -- base-query end
      AND t2.ccid != ''

      AND startsWith(t2.notes, 'non-usd-based-') = 0
  )
  WHERE rank_last_events_on_ex = 1
)

GROUP BY ccid
HAVING p_bid_fut != 0 AND p_ask_spot != 0
ORDER BY diff_rel DESC
LIMIT 20
